_note: PROPORTION PRIORS for dimensions a single photo cannot measure (felid, domestic shorthair). Every unobserved dimension of a build must sit inside its range; observed dimensions follow the photo. Ratios are relative to quantities the photo CAN measure (head width at the cheeks with fur = W_head, eye spacing = E). Sources: engine/references/cat-anatomy.md. Ranges are deliberately wide (small samples, breed variation); the target is the default when nothing else is known. Measured by engine/checks/priors.py in the head frame (fur envelope).

muzzle_projection_over_width.why: nose tip ahead of the cornea plane: skull ~90 mm with the face ~20 % of it, nasal bone ~21 mm + nasal cartilage -> ~25 mm ahead of the orbit rim; furred head ~90-110 mm wide. v29 = 0.10 (flat 'baby face').

forehead_slope_deg.why: smooth moderately convex forehead with a gentle concave stop (CFA); 90 = vertical wall. v29 = 61.

temple_bulge_min_px.why: temporalis fills the temporal fossa: the cheek -> ear-base outline is straight or convex, never concave (measured from the photo camera: head_outline.py). v29 = -4.6 / -6.0.

chin_behind_nose_over_width.why: upper lip larger than the lower and overhanging it; chin perpendicular under the upper lip in profile (CFA).

neck_min_width_over_head_width.why: cervical spine near vertical, the visible neck is a continuous muscle mass throat->sternum, no waist.

trunk_section_depth_over_width.why: thorax width/depth ~0.7-1.3 plus back muscles -> an upright oval.
